about:
Isoflex Packaging, headquartered in Vancouver, Washington, was founded in 1985 with the goal of introducing a new approach to the film industry. The company is minority-owned (NMSDC certified) and operates as a privately-held business.

The company produces specialty films for laminating, printing, coating, and converting markets. Its seven U.S. facilities run 24/7/365 on monolayer, three-, five-, and seven-layer co-extrusion lines, delivering a combined film and bag capacity of 350 million pounds per year. Core capabilities include high-performance barrier films, shrink films, custom bags, auto-insert packaging, non-shrink sheeting, and stretch hood films.

Isoflex serves food and beverage, consumer goods, institutional, industrial, agricultural, and medical/pharmaceutical sectors. Customers include converters, printers, and packagers seeking custom-engineered flexible packaging solutions.

Founded to pioneer a different way of making films, Isoflex emphasizes custom-engineered solutions for difficult packaging challenges. The company highlights sustainable manufacturing, offering How2Recycle®-labeled, post-consumer recycled, bio-based, compostable, and antimicrobial film options.
